verdict: Lead costs doubled on flat spend — volume is in a confirmed decline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 32 leads at an average cost of $33.70 per lead, but the most recent week tells a sharper story: cost per lead roughly doubled week-over-week while spend held almost flat, meaning each dollar is producing far fewer leads right now. The drop is showing up across both Meta and Google — Meta leads fell 50% week-over-week, with erratic daily ad delivery pointing to a pacing instability rather than audience fatigue. On a positive note, your Google Business Profile activity jumped 52% week-over-week, showing real organic demand in your area that paid campaigns are not yet capturing. We're stabilizing Meta delivery and realigning paid targeting to meet that organic demand; you should see cost-per-lead begin to recover over the next two weeks.
